description: General-arrangement drawing of a custom cable-management installation arranged around a large central rectangular deck/opening. The right-hand plan view is the principal connectivity map: a yellow custom aluminium trunking run forms a near-continuous perimeter around the central area, with chamfered/sloping top and bottom segments and vertical port/starboard side runs. At the left side, the perimeter run turns into a recessed/local equipment zone shown enlarged in the circular detail; cyan branch tray/conduit elements connect from this local zone toward the central area. A separate black perforated metal cable tray is shown in the lower-right isometric view running longitudinally inside/along the yellow perimeter trunking assembly. Section references 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 relate the plan to the surrounding transverse/longitudinal sectional views. The upper-left, middle-left, lower-left, and center sections show the trunking carried along deck/bulkhead edges, turning around structural boundaries and passing beside or below nearby outfitting. The BOM identifies the linked cable-management elements as custom 120W x 120H aluminium trunking and a bought-item 200W x 50H perforated metal cable tray, total listed weight 40.0 kg. Zones represented include the central deck/opening perimeter, a recessed left-side access/equipment zone, adjacent outer side-deck/outfitting bands, and structural deck/bulkhead sections. Many small drawing annotations are too blurred or OCR-corrupted to transcribe reliably; no unreadable equipment identifiers have been inferred.
